Art for a 2D top-down fantasy role-playing game. Bright, colorful medieval fantasy in clear daylight. Realistic proportions, nothing cartoonish, nothing grim. No text, no borders, no watermarks, no drop shadows.
Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent vegetation sprite sheet for Brasswake, tallyport region. Detailed hand-painted late-1990s Ultima Online-like game finish, rich natural bark and finely textured foliage, volumetric crowns with soft upper-left daylight. Raised camera from above and slightly in front about 35 degrees, not diagonal isometric. Natural believable shapes; no rounded cartoon bubbles.
Exactly 16 individually isolated assets in a perfectly regular 4 by 4 grid, even gutters at least 20 pixels; each object centered wholly in its cell, no touching, no cropped tips. No cell lines. Top eight cells are trees, all with visible trunks/stems and clear ground contact at bottom center. Species pair: coastal oak and silver birch. Palette: fresh deep green oak leaves; airy silver-green birch foliage and white bark.
Row 1 left to right: first species young sapling; first species slender young adult; first species broad mature tree; first species gnarled old tree with asymmetric crown and thick trunk.
Row 2 left to right: second species young sapling; second species slender young adult; second species mature tree; second species old tree with irregular branches. These are genuinely different silhouettes, branch structures and proportions, not resized copies. Mature trees tall and expansive within cell; saplings narrower and less full.
Row 3 and row 4 left to right, exactly one each: hazel bush; flowering dog rose shrub; fern clump; salt meadow grasses; oak leaf litter; exposed oak roots; fallen mossy oak log; weathered cut stump.
Ground debris pieces seen from the same raised camera, flat and loose, irregular alpha edges and gaps showing transparency, no oval soil bases. Trees stay upright; shrubs smaller low woody plants. Crisp readable fine painted detail at small game size, restrained realistic highlights.
No ground, no shadow, no grass, nothing behind the character or object. (The explicitly requested isolated grass clump itself is allowed.) No glow, haze or backdrop. Genuinely transparent background, never a baked checkerboard. No people, buildings, labels or decorative frame.
